title: KILOVAC LEV100 Series 900 Vdc Contactor, doc 6-1773450-9, date code 04-08 ((c)2008 Tyco Electronics)
method: Table values copied from the datasheet/product page text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Distributor-hosted (Waldom/Zoro) copy of the TE PDF; te.com direct download blocked by the network proxy. 900 VDC is the 'Main Contacts Switching (max)' voltage rating, but every hot-switching row is at 400 Vdc ('Hot Switching Performance (Polarity sensitive)'); no make/break rating at 450-900 V is stated in text. Load-life vs resistive power is a graph only and was not read. Release time 10 ms is printed without a 'Max.' label. Continuous 100 A per Note 1 depends on conductor size. Status from TE product spec pages: 4-1618391-0 'ACTIVE' (printed 02/21/2024, copy at https://atta.szlcsc.com/upload/public/pdf/source/20240415/6EA75236CED06679C8DBF59056DD05F9.pdf) and 4-1618391-1 '有效' (active, printed 05/10/2025, https://www.te.com.cn/chn-zh/product-4-1618391-1.datasheet.pdf). Applications listed include 'Automotive battery switching and backup'.

ratings.V_rated_note: Main contacts switching (max) 900 VDC; all tabulated life rows at 400 Vdc
ratings.I_carry_note: Continuous 100 A (depends on conductor size); 200 A for 3 min at +40 C with 8.4 mm2 (#8 AWG)
ratings.short_circuit_carry: 1,250 A (1/2 cycle, 60 Hz) through closed contacts
